Research themes
Human-Centred Computing
H2
We place people at the centre of technological innovation. Our researchers study how humans interact with digital systems and use those insights to design better ones.
Responsible AI
H2
We study how to build and deploy AI responsibly. Our work spans explainability, privacy, security, AI literacy, and the ethics of data collection.
Computing and Data Platforms
H2
A leading hub for innovative design and empirical understanding of scalable computing, data, and AI platforms that power software applications and emerging agentic ecosystems.
Modelling and Simulation of Complex Systems
H2
Complex systems research seeks to understand how collective behaviour, self-organisation, and critical phenomena emerge from interactions between many individual components in large systems.
Robotics, Embodied AI, and Physical Computing
H2
Robotics, Embodied AI, and Physical Computing research develops intelligent systems that are grounded in the physical world.
Software Development & Verification
H2
We advance the science and practice of building secure and reliable software systems, developing rigorous methods of software analysis, formal verification, and testing across the full spectrum of software development lifecycle.
Algorithms and Theory
H2
We investigate the fundamental aspects of computation, and how, through mathematically grounded modelling, they inform the design of efficient algorithmic solutions for real-world applications.
AI and Data Science for Health and Medicine
H2
We are advancing artificial intelligence (AI) and data science in health and medicine through computational methodologies that encompass data processing, management, visualisation, modelling, systems, and human–computer interaction.
Computing Education
H2
Our Computing Education research focuses on advancing evidence-based approaches that transform the student experience and shape the future of learning.
Decentralised Systems, Blockchain, Web3, and Digital Infrastructure
H2
We advance the technologies that underpin the next generation of digital infrastructure and services.
Foundations of AI
H2
We innovate in the models and methods that form the foundations of AI systems, making both theoretical and practical contributions across a wide range of areas.
Cybersecurity
H2
We advance both the foundations and practice of cybersecurity. Our work spans cryptography, distributed systems, privacy-preserving technologies, software, and the security of AI.
